pricing.markupHint: Applied on top of the provider cost for new usage only. Past usage keeps the markup it was recorded with.
pricing.pricesDescription: Synced from models.dev, in USD per 1M tokens (per minute for duration-priced models).
pricing.snapshotOld: Prices haven't been synced for more than 48 hours. Costs use the last known prices.
pricing.overrideHint: Used when models.dev has no direct price. Token prices are USD per 1M tokens; per minute is USD per audio minute.
pricing.unpricedDescription: These models are recorded at a cost of 0. Add a manual price so their usage is costed.
